PRs are rebase-merged: each commit lands on main as-is and can become its own changelog entry.
Every commit message must be a conventional commit, e.g. "feat: show tags in the legend" or
"fix(graph): misaligned merge curve". Use feat/fix/perf for user-facing changes;
docs/refactor/test/build/ci/chore don't appear in the changelog.
